determinism.note: Settings are pinned and repeated runs were byte-identical on this machine. use_deterministic_algorithms runs with warn_only=True, so the guarantee is measured rather than enforced -- an op with no deterministic variant would warn, not fail. Across machines the contract is 3 decimals (13.324% |B| / 9.207% torque).
